newsitem.title: USA: Shareholder files suit against Cellular Technical.
newsitem.headline: Shareholder files suit against Cellular Technical.

text.p: A shareholder of Cellular Technical Services Co Inc filed a purported class action lawsuit against the company, alleging the company's executives issued false and misleading statements.

According to the law firm of Cohen, Milstein, Hausfeld & Toll, the shareholder, Andrew Siben, filed the lawsuit in the United States District Court for the Western District of Washington against CTSC, and its Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Stephen Katz.
The action is brought as a class action on behalf of all persons who purchased CTSC common stock from November 14, 1996 through June 30, 1997.
